description: Formats PREFIX-YYYYMM-NNNNN-C with a Luhn check digit, or validates one. Returns { invoice } when formatting, or { valid } when validating. Price: 1 credit (1 credit = 1 CAD cent) per successful call; input that does not match the schema is rejected before billing.

sequence.description: Invoice sequence number. Required unless validate is given.

validate.description: An invoice number to check instead of formatting one; when given, the other fields are ignored.

yyyymm.description: Year and month as YYYYMM; defaults to the current UTC month.

name: invoice-number
title: Invoice number
